privacy.title: Privacy Policy
privacy.intro: SkaleFlow takes the protection of your personal data seriously. This page explains what data we collect through skaleflow.co, why, and how you can exercise your rights.

sections.heading: 1. Data controller
sections.body: The data controller for this site is Jawed Bensaih, trading as SkaleFlow, a French micro-entreprise registered under SIRET 10344668800014, with registered address 47 rue Vivienne 75002 Paris. Contact: contact@skaleflow.net.

sections.heading: 2. Data we collect
sections.body: We only collect data you provide to us directly: when booking a call (name, email address, and any information submitted through Calendly), and when completing our onboarding questionnaire (information about your business and needs, via Tally). This information is needed to handle your request; without it, we cannot schedule a call with you. We do not collect any other browsing data through non-essential cookies. We do not carry out any automated decision-making or profiling based on your data.

sections.heading: 3. Purpose of processing
sections.body: We use this data to: respond to your booking request, assess your needs ahead of an initial call, prepare and perform our contractual relationship if you become a client, and follow up with you regarding that relationship.

sections.heading: 4. Legal basis
sections.body: Processing is based on steps taken at your request prior to entering into a contract (booking a call, onboarding questionnaire), on the performance of a contract once you become a SkaleFlow client, and on our legitimate interest in following up on our business communications. Where we expressly ask for your consent, processing is based on that consent.

sections.heading: 5. Recipients and processors
sections.body: Your data is processed by SkaleFlow and shared only with the technical providers strictly necessary for our service: Calendly (call scheduling), Tally (onboarding questionnaire) and Vercel Inc. (website hosting). These providers act as data processors and are not permitted to use your data for any other purpose.

sections.heading: 6. International transfers
sections.body: Some of our providers (Calendly, Vercel Inc.) are located in the United States or may host data there. Where your data is transferred outside the UK or the European Economic Area, such transfers are protected by the EU-US Data Privacy Framework and the UK-US Data Bridge where the provider is certified, or otherwise by appropriate safeguards such as the Standard Contractual Clauses together with the UK Addendum. You can request a copy of these safeguards at contact@skaleflow.net.

sections.heading: 7. Data retention
sections.body: Your data is kept for as long as strictly necessary to manage our business relationship, then archived in line with applicable legal retention periods, before deletion or anonymisation. Prospects: 3 years from the last contact. Clients: duration of the contract + 5 years. Accounting records: 10 years.

sections.heading: 8. Cookies
sections.body: This site does not currently use any analytics or advertising cookies. Only cookies strictly necessary for the technical operation of the site may be set.

sections.heading: 9. Your rights
sections.body: Under the GDPR and, for individuals located in the UK, the UK GDPR and the Data Protection Act 2018, you have the right to access, rectify, erase, restrict, object to, and port your data. Where processing is based on your consent, you may withdraw it at any time, without affecting the lawfulness of processing carried out before withdrawal. To exercise these rights, contact us at contact@skaleflow.net: we will respond within one month. If you have a concern about how we handle your data, please contact us first so we can try to resolve it. You also have the right to lodge a complaint with the relevant supervisory authority (the CNIL in France, or the ICO in the UK).

sections.heading: 10. Hosting
sections.body: This site is hosted by Vercel Inc., which may process technical connection data strictly as part of hosting the site.
